text:
maria: Quick preflight check — target release 1.12.0 tomorrow 18:00 PT. Cutoff in ~12h. Please: bump package.json, add changelog entry, and keep PRs minimal. I'll lock the rc branch at cutoff. release-bot will run smoke tests 30m before deploy. Ping here when you open PRs.

devon: On it — making the version bump PR now, will tag with /bump. ETA ~2h.

sasha: FYI I hit a flaky in integration-suite on staging this morning. Might take 45m to root-cause.

maria: Thanks @sasha — if it's >1h we should decide about a short slip. @devon keep your PR small (no extra refactors).

devon: :thumbsup: keeping it minimal.

release-bot: release-bot: scheduled smoke run at 2026-03-17T17:30:00Z for thread 1793456789

jordan: If we need to slip, can we still run a limited canary on Dedicated? I can coordinate infra for a 1h window.

lee: I can hold the canary pool for 1h after cutoff if we decide to canary.

sasha: Update: found a race in cache invalidation. I have a fix branch (draft) — need a review. Might be a 30m patch.

maria: If fix lands <90m before cutoff we'll backport to rc; else mark as post-release patch. We'll make the call live.

devon: PR up: https://git/repo/pull/421 (version bump + changelog). @maria @sasha PTAL.

sasha: Reviewing now.

qa-bot: qa-bot: integration tests queued (suite: full). ETA ~25m.

sasha: One failing scenario, repro steps in the PR comments — env var mismatch. Pushing a tiny fix now.

maria: Quick poll: if tests still failing at cutoff do we: :one: slip 2h, or :two: proceed with canary? Reply with number.

jordan: :one: — slip 2h (safer).

lee: :one: as well.

devon: Leaning :two: if fix is tiny, but ok with :one: if it risks rollout stability.

sasha: Fix merged at 1793456830, backported to rc branch. QA re-running.

qa-bot: qa-bot: integration tests passed ✅ (run id: 5792).

release-bot: release-bot: rc branch locked at 1793456900; canary window reserved.

maria: OK we are green. Moving forward with announce plan — I'll post in #announcements at 17:45 PT and start the canary at 18:00 PT. Thanks all.

devon: Thanks — I'll watch the deploy and handle any immediate rollbacks.

sasha: Thx — will monitor staging metrics.

lee: I'll keep canary ready.

maria: Final note: changelog entry needs one-sentence blurb for the release notes. If anyone wants something highlighted ping me privately.
